name: openbb_equity_fundamental_ratios
description:
Financial ratios over several periods (valuation, profitability, liquidity, leverage) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.ratios).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, intrinio; default fmp).
Headline metrics: openbb_equity_metrics; keyless: yf_stock_info. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
